answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 41579 Country: India Title: zakaat for land purchased with the intention to sell it and build house in case of need of money to build the house Question: I bought a plot of land to build a house and also started building house in it, in the meantime I also bought another land so that when I require more money for building the house in my first purchased land, I can sell the second land so that even if the construction expenses increases, then the land price will also increase hence increasing price of building materials will not be a problem for me. Please let me know if I have to pay zakah for the second land that I purchased. Answer ID: 41579 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1554/1152/D=1433) Zakah is not wajib on any of the two land plots. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
